rv.q: The word that kept coming to my mind while watching Munich Medea , a co-production of WP Theater and PlayCo, is “crystalline”: clear, sharp, and liable to make you bleed.
Teddy’s mélange of memory is what makes you don’t have to do anything shine.

cn.t: Critics find this intimate coming-of-age story at HERE effectively staged in its tight underground space, with strong performances anchoring a school-set narrative that resonates despite its modest production values.
